section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of side gear backlash using a dial indicator mounted on differential housing while holding pinion gear

content.text: Measure the side gear backlash while holding one pinion gear toward the case.
If the backlash is out of specification, install the correct thrust washer. (See step 5 on page RA-27)

content.description: Illustration showing hand checking tooth contact on differential gear
Illustration showing measurement of drive pinion preload using a torque wrench

content.text: Using a torque wrench, measure the preload of the backlash between the drive pinion and ring gear.
Using a torque wrench, measure the total preload.

content.component: Total preload: In addition to drive pinion preload

items: (a) Using a hammer and chisel, loosen the staked part of the nut.
